digitized.method: Fig. 4, 5, 8 charge–discharge curves = centroids of the coloured dash shapes / black stroke segments from the PDF vector paths, calibrated on the vector major ticks (Fig. 4: x 92.16→258.55 pt = 0→80 mAh g-1, y per panel 20.28 pt/V; Fig. 5: x 352.01→528.38 = 0→80, y 58.86→235.94 = 5→0 V; Fig. 8: bottom ticks x 343.28→532.87 = 0→120, y 58.74→236.41 = 5→0 V); every 3rd point kept plus the charge end (max Q) and the discharge end (max Q with V < 2.5 V), flagged 'END'; Fig. 7 Nyquist = all marker centroids (x 81.69→258.97 pt = 0→1200 Ω; y per panel −400→0 Ω over 27.3 pt). Dash centroids sit up to half a dash inside the true curve end: ±1 mAh g-1.
